$comment: Member kinds this lexicon supplies to a chant workspace (#2545). chant reads this file as data and never imports the lexicon. Both probes are behold's, narrowed to the member's own directory: a choudoufu estate is a Terraform root with an estate.chdf.hcl sidecar or a live block, and the lexicon's choudoufu mode (#2103) reads it, so the kind lives here.

kinds.name: terraform
kinds.description: a Terraform root module, with a .tf file directly in its directory

kinds.name: choudoufu
kinds.description: a choudoufu estate: a Terraform root with an estate.chdf.hcl sidecar or a live block in one of its .tf files
